title: DR-15c: safe_aad check uses post-Commit GroupContext
description: Refines DR-15b (mimid-1wgh.4.45). A Commit may change the GroupContext required safe_aad/app_components lists and add members at once. Readings: (a) judge new/updated leaves against the pre-Commit lists; (b) against the post-Commit lists. Chosen: (b): the leaves must be able to operate in the epoch they join. GREASE in a GroupContext list is ignored (not rejected at create), per DR-15b. A malformed leaf list counts as empty (AGENTS.md untrusted-extension rule); a malformed GroupContext list after a Commit fails closed (refusing an AppDataUpdate that writes one).
